Bus Collisions in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh Injure Dozens

Two separate bus collisions have resulted in numerous injuries. In Andhra Pradesh's Tirupati, a speeding Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) bus collided with a lorry, injuring 16 people. Separately, near Yellapur in Karnataka, a collision involving two buses left 26 people injured. Specific details on the cause of the Yellapur collision were not provided in the coverage.
